title: Cinnamon — a personal AI agent your family can actually share
excerpt: Agentic AI for your household. Not a chatbot. Not a developer tool. Launching 2026.
content_html:
cinnamon

Cinnamon plans, books, watches and reminds, for you and up to five people you trust. It always asks before it acts.

Try for free

From the team that ran AI for billions of users at Facebook, Instagram and Amazon. Start with 25 free trial credits.

1 · Ask

2 · Watch

3 · Approve

Plan a trip

Resorts, flights for four, a shared itinerary everyone can react to.

Tidy the inbox

A morning digest of what actually needs a reply. Drafts ready to send.

Run the calendar

Appointments, forms, renewals. Reminders that land before, not after.

Watch a price

Tell it a number. It waits, then tells you when it's time.

Shared and private

Two spaces. One agent.

Everything in the household space is visible to the household: the ski trip, the chore rota, the Sunday digest. Everything in your personal space is yours alone. Cinnamon never mixes them, and it tells you which one you're in.

Eyes open

A task is running. Cinnamon is researching, comparing, waiting on a reply.

Eyes closed

Done, or paused until something changes. Nothing happens without you.

Shared · The Riveras

Personal · Only you

Safety

Built so a mistake can't cost you.

Every email, booking, purchase or share stops for your approval and shows exactly what will happen. Your passwords and cards live in a vault the agent can't read. Every action is in a timeline you can inspect, export or delete.

Approve, don't hope

One-time, this task, or 7 days. You pick the scope.

Nothing to leak

The agent only ever sees stand-in tokens, never real logins.

Isolated by default

Each task runs in its own sandbox with no open doors.

Your data, your rules

No ads, no training on your conversations, delete anytime.

Cinnamon, the real one

Why Cinnamon?

Named after a feral calico cat who chose us.

Cinnamon is our cat: orange over one ear, black over the other, white everywhere else, green eyes, and quietly in charge of the house. While we were building an AI agent for families, she was the obvious name for the project. The name stuck, and so did her colours: the cream, the orange and the black on this page are hers.

She is also how the app tells you what it's doing. When the cat's eyes are open, Cinnamon is working on something for you. When they're closed, the task is done or waiting, and nothing happens until you say so. Like the real one, she asks before she jumps on the counter.

working

done or waiting

Founding Team & Leadership

The team behind Cinnamon.

Built by infrastructure veterans and systems architects with decades of experience delivering distributed platforms and AI systems to hundreds of millions of users.

Michael is the founder and CEO of Cinnamon. He brings over two decades of technical leadership building high-availability distributed systems, large-scale ML infrastructure, and real-time consumer platforms. Michael specializes in taking complex systems from 0-to-1, with an operational focus on privacy-preserving architectures, accelerator economics, and dependable agentic workflows.

Prior to founding Cinnamon, Michael built Meta’s ML capacity forecasting and management framework for Instagram and Reality Labs through global GPU constraints, owned core streaming protocols serving tens of millions of concurrent live viewers at Amazon Prime Video, and co-founded edge-AI video analytics company Monitoreal (deployed across airports and critical transit infrastructure) as well as global CDN pioneer Advection (scaled to 1B+ monthly streams).

Professional Experience & Track Record

Meta Technical Program Manager

Helped build Meta's ML capacity modeling, forecasting, and infrastructure framework across compute, storage, network, and GPU capacity for Instagram and Reality Labs; supported long-range planning and allocation decisions at the executive level.

Amazon Prime Video Principal Technical PM

Owned roadmap and execution for Amazon’s proprietary low-latency, globally synchronized live-event delivery protocol, aligning engineering teams across Seattle, LA, London, and Stockholm serving tens of millions of concurrent viewers.

Monitoreal Co-Founder & Product Strategy

Led edge-AI computer vision appliances and multi-tenant cloud platform from concept to enterprise deployments at Portland International Airport, NYC DEP, and NYC MTA critical infrastructure.

Advection Co-Founder

Built and operated global high-performance CDN scaled to 1B streams/month across 8 data centers worldwide, managing 24×7 NOC operations, carrier peering, and a 25+ person engineering organization.

Patents & Education: Object detection in video streams (US20200117905) · Network metaswitch communications (US20010027491) · B.Sc. Computer Science

Active Founder & Principal Operator

Why Our Team Background Matters

Consumer AI requires enterprise-grade discipline.

Household tasks involve real family calendars, medical appointments, school forms, and utility bills. We architect Cinnamon with strict multi-tenant data boundaries, zero unauthorized cross-principal data leakage, and a verified approval loop before any action is executed.

FAQ

Questions people ask first.

Do I need a household to use Cinnamon?

No. Every account starts with a private space that's yours alone. When you're ready, invite up to five family members or close friends into a group; shared tasks show up for everyone, your private space stays private.

What data do you store about me?

The tasks Cinnamon runs, and a memory of preferences you can read, edit or delete at any time. We do not store your conversation history with Cinnamon once a session ends. Passwords and payment details are never stored where Cinnamon can read them. We don't show ads and don't train models on your data.

What can Cinnamon actually do on my behalf?

Monitor and summarize your connected Gmail mailbox (surfacing financial transactions, school notices, youth sports, and other family activities), prepare draft inquiry emails in your Gmail Drafts folder when exploring options and reaching out to providers, check your schedule and help you add important events to your calendar, research and compare products and local services, design tailored meal plans and exercise programs, and help you prepare for job interviews. Cinnamon never sends emails on its own, modifies your calendar directly, or spends money without your direct action.

Can my household see my personal tasks?

Only what you put in the shared space. A job search, a gift or an appointment in your personal space is invisible to the group, and Cinnamon never mixes the two. You choose where each task lives when you start it.

What does it cost?

Every new account starts with a free trial (25 task credits). After your trial, plans start at $9.99/month for the Personal Plan (50 credits/mo for 1 member), $19.99/month for the Group Plan (150 shared credits/mo for up to 6 members), and $99.99/month for Group Plan Max (1,000 shared credits/mo for up to 10 members). Both Group Plans include every member’s private Personal Space for $0.

Why isn’t there a free tier like other assistants offer?

Because “free” usually means you’re paying with your data. We don’t harvest your personal information or use it to train ad targeting. Instead, Cinnamon is funded by the people who use it, which lets us run a sustainable business and keep the experience fast, responsive, and high quality.

Plan a trip

Shared and private

Nothing to leak

The agent only ever sees stand-in tokens, never real logins.

Isolated by default

Each task runs in its own sandbox with no open doors.

Your data, your rules

No ads, no training on your conversations, delete anytime.

Cinnamon, the real one

Why Cinnamon?

Named after a feral calico cat who chose us.

Cinnamon is our cat: orange over one ear, black over the other, white everywhere else, green eyes, and quietly in charge of the house. While we were building an AI agent for families, she was the obvious name for the project. The name stuck, and so did her colours: the cream, the orange and the black on this page are hers.

She is also how the app tells you what it's doing. When the cat's eyes are open, Cinnamon is working on something for you. When they're closed, the task is done or waiting, and nothing happens until you say so. Like the real one, she asks before she jumps on the counter.

Founding Team & Leadership

The team behind Cinnamon.

Built by infrastructure veterans and systems architects with decades of experience delivering distributed platforms and AI systems to hundreds of millions of users.

Michael is the founder and CEO of Cinnamon. He brings over two decades of technical leadership building high-availability distributed systems, large-scale ML infrastructure, and real-time consumer platforms. Michael specializes in taking complex systems from 0-to-1, with an operational focus on privacy-preserving architectures, accelerator economics, and dependable agentic workflows.

Prior to founding Cinnamon, Michael built Meta’s ML capacity forecasting and management framework for Instagram and Reality Labs through global GPU constraints, owned core streaming protocols serving tens of millions of concurrent live viewers at Amazon Prime Video, and co-founded edge-AI video analytics company Monitoreal (deployed across airports and critical transit infrastructure) as well as global CDN pioneer Advection (scaled to 1B+ monthly streams).

Professional Experience & Track Record

Meta Technical Program Manager

Helped build Meta's ML capacity modeling, forecasting, and infrastructure framework across compute, storage, network, and GPU capacity for Instagram and Reality Labs; supported long-range planning and allocation decisions at the executive level.

Amazon Prime Video Principal Technical PM

Owned roadmap and execution for Amazon’s proprietary low-latency, globally synchronized live-event delivery protocol, aligning engineering teams across Seattle, LA, London, and Stockholm serving tens of millions of concurrent viewers.

Monitoreal Co-Founder & Product Strategy

Led edge-AI computer vision appliances and multi-tenant cloud platform from concept to enterprise deployments at Portland International Airport, NYC DEP, and NYC MTA critical infrastructure.

Advection Co-Founder

Built and operated global high-performance CDN scaled to 1B streams/month across 8 data centers worldwide, managing 24×7 NOC operations, carrier peering, and a 25+ person engineering organization.

Patents & Education: Object detection in video streams (US20200117905) · Network metaswitch communications (US20010027491) · B.Sc. Computer Science

Active Founder & Principal Operator

Why Our Team Background Matters

Consumer AI requires enterprise-grade discipline.

Household tasks involve real family calendars, medical appointments, school forms, and utility bills. We architect Cinnamon with strict multi-tenant data boundaries, zero unauthorized cross-principal data leakage, and a verified approval loop before any action is executed.

FAQ

Questions people ask first.

Do I need a household to use Cinnamon?

No. Every account starts with a private space that's yours alone. When you're ready, invite up to five family members or close friends into a group; shared tasks show up for everyone, your private space stays private.

What data do you store about me?

The tasks Cinnamon runs, and a memory of preferences you can read, edit or delete at any time. We do not store your conversation history with Cinnamon once a session ends. Passwords and payment details are never stored where Cinnamon can read them. We don't show ads and don't train models on your data.

What can Cinnamon actually do on my behalf?

Monitor and summarize your connected Gmail mailbox (surfacing financial transactions, school notices, youth sports, and other family activities), prepare draft inquiry emails in your Gmail Drafts folder when exploring options and reaching out to providers, check your schedule and help you add important events to your calendar, research and compare products and local services, design tailored meal plans and exercise programs, and help you prepare for job interviews. Cinnamon never sends emails on its own, modifies your calendar directly, or spends money without your direct action.

Can my household see my personal tasks?

Only what you put in the shared space. A job search, a gift or an appointment in your personal space is invisible to the group, and Cinnamon never mixes the two. You choose where each task lives when you start it.

What does it cost?

Every new account starts with a free trial (25 task credits). After your trial, plans start at $9.99/month for the Personal Plan (50 credits/mo for 1 member), $19.99/month for the Group Plan (150 shared credits/mo for up to 6 members), and $99.99/month for Group Plan Max (1,000 shared credits/mo for up to 10 members). Both Group Plans include every member’s private Personal Space for $0.

Why isn’t there a free tier like other assistants offer?

Because “free” usually means you’re paying with your data. We don’t harvest your personal information or use it to train ad targeting. Instead, Cinnamon is funded by the people who use it, which lets us run a sustainable business and keep the experience fast, responsive, and high quality.
